events.brand: White House Black Market × Saint Coffee
events.address: Saint Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-morning NYFW coffee pop-up where White House Black Market previews its fall collection at Saint Coffee.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee is advertised, with the first 150 guests receiving the signature latte. Black-and-white cookies are also advertised, with current listings noting limited quantities.
events.caveats: Current sources describe the event as open to the public. Promotional coffee and cookies are quantity-limited, so specific freebies may run out before the listed end time. No advance RSVP or host-approval requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 8 AM–1 PM at Saint Coffee, 201 Seventh Avenue. Walk-in public access; arrive early for the limited complimentary items.

events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW public pop-up built as a between-shows refresh space with Calzedonia legwear, content moments, beauty touch-ups and refreshments.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free coffee beverages, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups, a photobooth and beauty-partner sampling. Embroidery is tied to purchase of selected hosiery.
events.caveats: Public-event sources describe the pop-up as open to the public. Free samples, coffee and other promotional items are subject to on-site availability. Free embroidery requires purchase of the specified Calzedonia hosiery item.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 and Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is established in the current public listings.
